result.instructions: Tools for Swell, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Swell data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run swell_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run swell_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run swell_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. swell_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: swell_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products in the store, with MongoDB-style filtering, sorting, search, field selection, and expansion. Swell backend REST API: GET /products.

limit.description: Max records to return (1–1000, Swell default 15).

where.description: MongoDB-style filter as a JSON object string, e.g. {"active":true,"price":{"$gte":10}}.

sort.description: Sort expression, e.g. "date_created desc" or "name asc".

expand.description: Comma-separated related fields to expand, e.g. "variants,categories".

search.description: Free-text search across the model's searchable fields.

tools.name: swell_get_product
tools.title: Get a product
tools.description: Fetch a single product by its record id or its slug. Supports `expand` and `fields`. Swell backend REST API: GET /products/{id}.

expand.description: Comma-separated related fields to expand, e.g. "variants,categories".

tools.name: swell_query
tools.title: Query any collection (read-only)
tools.description: Power tool: read-only (GET only) access to ANY Swell model not covered by a dedicated tool — e.g. stock, promotions, giftcards, payments, shipments, settings. Supply the collection name plus the usual list params (limit, page, where, sort, expand, fields, search). Swell backend REST API: GET /{collection}.

limit.description: Max records to return (1–1000, Swell default 15).

where.description: MongoDB-style filter as a JSON object string, e.g. {"active":true,"price":{"$gte":10}}.

sort.description: Sort expression, e.g. "date_created desc" or "name asc".

expand.description: Comma-separated related fields to expand, e.g. "variants,categories".

search.description: Free-text search across the model's searchable fields.

tools.name: swell_create_product
tools.title: Create a product
tools.description: MUTATES LIVE STORE DATA. Create a new product in the store. Provide the common fields directly (name is required); anything else goes in `fields`, which is merged into the request body. Swell backend REST API: POST /products.

fields.description: Any additional product fields, merged into the request body (e.g. attributes, options, images).

tools.name: swell_update_product
tools.title: Update a product
tools.description: MUTATES LIVE STORE DATA. Partially update an existing product by id. Provide the id plus a `fields` object of attributes to change. Swell backend REST API: PUT /products/{id}.

fields.description: Partial set of product attributes to update, e.g. {"price":19.99,"active":false}.

tools.name: swell_update_order
tools.title: Update an order
tools.description: MUTATES A LIVE ORDER. Partially update an existing order by id — e.g. change status, fulfillment, or notes. Provide the id plus a `fields` object of attributes to change, e.g. {"status":"complete"}. Swell backend REST API: PUT /orders/{id}.

fields.description: Partial set of order attributes to update, e.g. {"status":"complete"} or fulfillment fields.
